note: Distinct premium payer+trigger+completed outcome; source prices are seller offers not proof paid priority tiers. #832 final proof and #833 structural assessment are different purchased outputs. #837 includes physical photography by design as a rapid S0 kill, not claimed to be a digital service.

cases.payer: UK small retailer ordering urgently branded adhesive product labels
cases.trigger: Packaging or stock shipment requires custom printed labels produced 24h instead of normal queue
cases.money_evidence: UK online label printer advertises 24h Super Express at **£100 + 50%** of calculator base; 48h Express £50 +25%; seller offer, not an observed paid surcharge
cases.complete_paid_outcome: Completed physically printed approved labels and dispatch within stated hours
cases.convenience_vs_nonsoftware: Premium buys machine scheduling, substrate availability, physical production and courier, not digitisation speed
cases.input_output: Approved label artwork + physical material specification -> correct printed batch/dispatch
cases.verification: Print preflight can check artwork, not manufacture/dispatch sticker rolls
cases.competitors: label.co.uk express production and direct UK print competitors
cases.repeat_ai: AI can proof layout but cannot run printing/dispatch
cases.ai_build: Digital label generator cannot deliver actual labels; third-party manufacturing adds support/capital
cases.recurrence_first_ten: Retailer may reorder often, but autonomous software cannot take over the full purchase
cases.strongest_kill: Physical manufacture and express shipping comprise paid priority, not a standalone digital job
cases.cheapest_falsification: No software output equivalent to dispatched label stock

cases.payer: UK academic researcher needing verbatim interviews for near-term analysis
cases.trigger: Interview/focus-group audio must be accurately transcribed in a day
cases.money_evidence: UK Transcription current public rate £2/min for 1 day versus £1.20/min for 3 weeks, **£0.80/min acceleration** before surcharges
cases.complete_paid_outcome: Complete time-ordered verbatim human-checked transcript suitable for coding, including hard accents and diarisation
cases.convenience_vs_nonsoftware: Fee buys human transcriber capacity for difficult speech, data privacy and review, not simply computational latency
cases.input_output: Recorded consented audio + requested strict verbatim tags -> corrected transcript with speaker labels
cases.verification: Character error rate against human reference measurable after cost of making ground truth; tricky crosstalk/unintelligibles require human judgment
cases.competitors: UK Transcription, PageSix, Otter, Whisper and other cloud ASR
cases.repeat_ai: Models transcribe clean interviews quickly, but repeat multi-speaker overlap/hard accents and requested exact verbatim frequently require corrective review
cases.ai_build: AI-built pipeline plus ASR is easy and already commercial, can't capture full human-checked SLA without paying human editors
cases.recurrence_first_ten: Academics and research agencies reachable but ten high-frequency paid 1-day interview buyers unverified
cases.strongest_kill: The economic delta is scheduling reliable manual accuracy; cannot take same fee for self-serve model transcript
cases.cheapest_falsification: No independent purchaser documented selecting a human-free model for equivalent research-ready deliverable

cases.payer: UK independent writer finalising a self-published novel
cases.trigger: Final manuscript proof needed in 2 rather than 4 weeks
cases.money_evidence: Jericho Writers: standard **£285**, express **£355**, exact **£70** increase for earlier handback
cases.complete_paid_outcome: Fully proofread manuscript with tracked corrections returned in 2 weeks
cases.convenience_vs_nonsoftware: Customer buys professional editorial judgement and editor access/queue, with some speed gain but not fully software-replaceable
cases.input_output: Final Word manuscript -> editor-reviewed corrected text with acceptable consistency
cases.verification: Spelling errors partly mechanically detectable; contextual narrative nuance not objectively verifiable
cases.competitors: Jericho Writers, Microsoft Editor, Grammarly, ProWritingAid
cases.repeat_ai: LLM can generate plausible proofreading suggestions instantly; repeated subtle stylistic edits and typo detection not accountable
cases.ai_build: AI-built proofreading UI trivial and substitutes only DIY lane, while bought service includes human proofreader
cases.recurrence_first_ten: Self-publishing authors available via communities, but repeat title frequency low
cases.strongest_kill: £70 pays for moving qualified human editorial work ahead, not automated compute
cases.cheapest_falsification: No evidence for equivalent unattended proof that author pays extra for versus grammar tools

cases.payer: UK aspiring author requiring structural manuscript assessment before revision deadline
cases.trigger: Full developmental diagnosis report required in 2 weeks rather than 4
cases.money_evidence: Jericho Writers: manuscript assessment **£415 standard vs £515 express**, **£100** acceleration
cases.complete_paid_outcome: Specialist structural feedback report of pacing, characterisation, genre and actionable revision suggestions
cases.convenience_vs_nonsoftware: Differentiated purchased result is deep human literary judgement, not arithmetic proofreading or document QA
cases.input_output: Draft book -> reasoned editorial assessment with recommendations
cases.verification: Human author acceptance only; no deterministic measure of good pacing or marketability
cases.competitors: Jericho Writers, general AI manuscript critiques and human editors
cases.repeat_ai: LLM repeats generic scene critiques, unreliable long-book continuity and editorial originality
cases.ai_build: AI-built narrative evaluator is easy to prototype, not equivalent to responsible human editor reading full book
cases.recurrence_first_ten: Indie authors reachable but service infrequent and expertise trust core
cases.strongest_kill: Separate from #832 final error-proofing: buyer seeks substantive structural diagnosis, not typo correction; still impossible to deliver same independently verified result without human expertise
cases.cheapest_falsification: No complete credible replacement at premium human-editor trust

cases.payer: UK microbusiness with WordPress shop unavailable during sales hours
cases.trigger: Urgent existing WordPress checkout/critical failure diagnosis and repair must start within an hour
cases.money_evidence: UK web studio sells **priority fix from £149** versus **standard fix £89**, extra **£60** for work-start SLA; separate security-cleansing service exists at £59
cases.complete_paid_outcome: Live website function restored, critical cause corrected and tested under paid hour-start SLA
cases.convenience_vs_nonsoftware: Premium largely buys expert engineer on call now, secure admin/hosting access and accountable restore without worsening state
cases.input_output: Access to WordPress and hosting, error symptoms -> working checkout/site, documented fix and tested rollback
cases.verification: HTTP/checkout smoke and WordPress debug logs objective, but root causes and security implications vary wildly
cases.competitors: Samson Web Design, WordPress managed hosts and AI website debuggers; fixed.net security cleanup
cases.repeat_ai: AI can diagnose a known plugin error with logs, cannot autonomously and safely operate arbitrary hacked live shop without credentials, staging and supervision
cases.ai_build: AI-build incident bot possible for narrow plugins, but urgent hosting/checkout production credential risk makes solo passive operation unsound
cases.recurrence_first_ten: UK WordPress microshops reachable, no ten verified recurrent buyer need; emergencies episodic
cases.strongest_kill: Full paid work is urgent human authority to touch production safely; £60 premium won't cover standalone tool liability
cases.cheapest_falsification: A narrow deterministic rollback task needs a separate recurring buyer proof, not this full incident contract

cases.payer: UK organiser of multi-day conference needing event-day sponsor social highlights
cases.trigger: Highlight reel and cutdowns needed during event/overnight rather than ordinary week-later edit
cases.money_evidence: UK video provider advertises same-day edit add-on **£400–£1,500+**; overnight edit from **+£900**; where filming bundled original commercial package can exceed £1,700
cases.complete_paid_outcome: Finished brand-approved highlight reel plus social clips before conference closes, not only transcript snippets
cases.convenience_vs_nonsoftware: High acceleration payment buys reserved editor, ingest capacity and event coverage communication, with manual clip/editorial selection
cases.input_output: Already supplied/licensed event footage + sponsor brand guidelines -> same-day edited broadcast/social pack
cases.verification: Encoding, aspect ratio, sponsor/logo placement mechanically testable; story/selection and interview permissions need editorial judgment
cases.competitors: WeStream event production, Descript, Runway, Adobe Premiere and day-rate editors
cases.repeat_ai: AI rough-cuts and captioning reduce editing hours but can't reliably create sponsor-appropriate event narrative every time
cases.ai_build: AI editing agents exist, while large raw footage files, delivery QA, approvals and permissions remain labour/support bottlenecks
cases.recurrence_first_ten: Events and conferences UK available in directories but first ten running onsite edited content bought independently not proved
cases.strongest_kill: Priority fee is reserved human editor and storage/field access, not objectively testable AI clipping alone
cases.cheapest_falsification: Find repeated buyer budgets for footage-already-delivered no-shoot fully digital highlight packs and measure end-to-end unattended acceptance

cases.payer: UK professional getting retouched headshots for urgent corporate press profile
cases.trigger: Selected existing portrait files must be professionally retouched in 24h instead of 7 workdays
cases.money_evidence: UK London photographer says rush retouch delivery fee **approximately £50 per image**, often at retoucher discretion; no standard service comparison price published, surcharge offered
cases.complete_paid_outcome: High-end approved image matching subject's real likeness and professional standards within 24h
cases.convenience_vs_nonsoftware: Buyer pays for professional retoucher's immediate availability, flattering but authentic edits and reputation; raw photo already exists
cases.input_output: Client-approved portrait RAW/JPEG -> retouched high-res and online formats within SLA
cases.verification: Image resolution checkable, tasteful skin/likeness edits require human approval
cases.competitors: Portrait retouchers, Lightroom, PortraitPro, Photoshop neural tools
cases.repeat_ai: AI retouch tools handle generic skin/lighting instantly; subjective specific likeness and revision judgment matter at high fee
cases.ai_build: Another retouch app faces Adobe & dedicated AI portrait editing, cannot claim £50/image without human QA
cases.recurrence_first_ten: Lawyers, consultants and corporate speakers, event-triggered irregular jobs and unproven ten willing buyers
cases.strongest_kill: Although output is digital, +£50 buys manual editing slot, not software delay; no evidence scalable separate buyer spend for same AI output
cases.cheapest_falsification: Would need repeated buyer selecting AI over retoucher for exact approved portrait quality at a defensible price

cases.payer: UK ecommerce merchant requiring new catalogue product photographs fast
cases.trigger: Physical products must be photographed, colour-corrected and finished in 72 hours rather than standard 7–10 days
cases.money_evidence: Knightsbridge Visual offers **+£5/photo** for 72h guaranteed over baseline £10–£20/shot, and 24h quote; current price supersedes older conflicting provider page with +£15/shot
cases.complete_paid_outcome: Genuine photographed product images delivered corrected for listing on deadline, not synthetic product visualizations
cases.convenience_vs_nonsoftware: Money is for camera capture, studio queue, physical products and retouchers, not only export or upscaling
cases.input_output: Physical items -> authentic accurately photographed imagery within SLA
cases.verification: File size, background and specs checkable, faithful physical appearance depends on professional shooting
cases.competitors: UK product studios, smartphone studio setups, AI photo background generators
cases.repeat_ai: AI can edit product photos provided, but can't capture real unseen objects in controlled lighting remotely
cases.ai_build: New AI background app delivers partial job; replacing physical studio service impossible
cases.recurrence_first_ten: Shopify merchants accessible; no independently purchased digital-only rush subset found
cases.strongest_kill: Fundamental physical imaging and dispatch of customer stock, express slot to studio staff; a SaaS app cannot deliver same job
cases.cheapest_falsification: Reject as software replacement unless buyer explicitly pays for outsourced digital-only edits after completed shots
